title: SolarWinds Orion supply-chain compromise
summary: CISA reported active exploitation involving affected SolarWinds Orion software versions.
uncertaintyNotes: Exact occurrence date, complete victim list and attack-technique links are outside this seed's verified scope.

title: Shai-Hulud npm ecosystem compromise
summary: CISA issued an alert describing a self-replicating npm ecosystem supply-chain compromise and attempted credential theft.
uncertaintyNotes: Affected individual packages and versions require package-level primary evidence before asserting links.
No ATT&CK technique is asserted until a separate sourced mapping review.

title: Toyota T-Connect access key exposed on public GitHub
summary: A development subcontractor published part of the T-Connect website source code, including a customer data server access key, to a public GitHub repository, where it stayed for almost five years.
uncertaintyNotes: Toyota reported it could not confirm or rule out use of the key from server access history.
Disclosure date follows Toyota's October 2022 statement as reported; the exact publication date of the statement is not separately sourced here.

title: Microsoft AI research SAS token exposed 38TB
summary: A Microsoft AI research GitHub repository shared an Azure Storage link whose SAS token granted access to the whole storage account, exposing 38TB of private data including workstation backups.
uncertaintyNotes: Microsoft reported its investigation found no other unintended access and no customer data exposure.
Researcher-found exposure, not a reported attack.

title: tj-actions/changed-files GitHub Action compromise
summary: A malicious change to the tj-actions/changed-files GitHub Action caused CI/CD secrets to be printed into GitHub Actions build logs for repositories using it.
uncertaintyNotes: The 23,000-repository figure is usage of the Action, not a count of confirmed leaks.
Public repositories with public workflow logs carried the highest exposure.

title: Codecov Bash Uploader compromise
summary: An attacker used a credential extracted from a Codecov Docker image to alter the Bash Uploader script so it sent customers' CI environment variables to an outside server.
uncertaintyNotes: Codecov reported periodic unauthorized changes from 31 January 2021 until discovery on 1 April 2021.
Which customers' secrets were actually used is not established by this source.

title: CircleCI breach via malware on an engineer's laptop
summary: Malware on a CircleCI engineer's laptop stole a valid 2FA-backed SSO session, and CircleCI advised all customers to rotate secrets stored in the platform.
uncertaintyNotes: CircleCI stated it could not know whether exfiltrated customer secrets were used against third-party systems.

title: Cloudflare Atlassian intrusion using credentials missed in rotation
summary: After the October 2023 Okta compromise, Cloudflare failed to rotate one service token and three service accounts it believed unused; an attacker used them to reach its Confluence wiki and Jira.
uncertaintyNotes: Attribution to a suspected nation-state actor is Cloudflare's assessment.

title: Okta support system breach exposing session tokens in HAR files
summary: An attacker accessed Okta's support case system and viewed customer-uploaded HAR troubleshooting files, some containing session tokens later used to hijack customer sessions.
uncertaintyNotes: Okta later reported files of 134 customers were accessed and five customers' sessions were hijacked; that follow-up is not separately sourced here.

title: Uber intrusion via admin credentials in a PowerShell script
summary: After social engineering a contractor, an attacker reportedly found a PowerShell script on an internal network share with hardcoded admin credentials for Uber's privileged access management system.
uncertaintyNotes: Details of the script come largely from the attacker's own statements, as reported.

title: Cloud extortion campaign using exposed .env files
summary: Attackers scanned for publicly exposed .env files on web applications, took AWS access keys from them, and used the access to steal and ransom cloud storage data.
uncertaintyNotes: Unit 42 reported 110,000 targeted domains and over 90,000 unique variables; the number of extorted victims is not given here.
Actor identity is not established.

title: Python infrastructure admin GitHub token leaked in a Docker Hub image
summary: A classic GitHub token with admin access to Python, PyPI and PSF organizations was found in a compiled .pyc file inside a public Docker Hub image, though not in the matching source file.
uncertaintyNotes: Researcher-found exposure; PyPI reported no evidence of malicious use.
PyPI could not date token creation exactly because logs older than 90 days were unavailable.

title: Storm-0558 acquisition of a Microsoft consumer signing key
summary: Microsoft's leading hypothesis is that a consumer signing key left its secure environment and was accessed in a corporate debugging environment through a compromised engineer account.
uncertaintyNotes: Microsoft's March 2024 update says it has not found a crash dump containing the key; the crash-dump path is a hypothesis.
Log retention limits prevent direct evidence of exfiltration.
